import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import pickle
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from scipy.stats import entropy
import random
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set up paths
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load training and test data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_test_2.csv")
sample_df = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_sample_submission_2.csv")

# Save sample submission as template for format consistency
template_columns = list(sample_df.columns)

# Extract token_id and sentence_id for reference
train_ids = [
    "{}_{}".format(train_df["sentence_id"].iloc[i], train_df["token_id"].iloc[i])
    for i in range(len(train_df))
]
test_ids = [
    "{}_{}".format(test_df["sentence_id"].iloc[i], test_df["token_id"].iloc[i])
    for i in range(len(test_df))
]


# Feature Engineering - Token Properties
def create_token_features(before_text):
    features = {}
    features["length"] = len(str(before_text))
    features["upper_ratio"] = sum(1 for c in str(before_text) if c.isupper()) / max(
        len(str(before_text)), 1
    )
    features["num_digits"] = sum(1 for c in str(before_text) if c.isdigit())
    features["has_trans"] = "_trans" in str(before_text)
    features["num_punct"] = sum(1 for c in str(before_text) if c in ".,;-:!?")
    features["num_space"] = sum(1 for c in str(before_text) if c.isspace())
    features["word_char_count"] = len(set(list(str(before_text))))
    return features


# Create features for training data
train_features = []
for _, row in train_df.iterrows():
    feat = create_token_features(row["before"])
    train_features.append(feat)

train_features = pd.DataFrame(train_features)
train_features.insert(0, "before", train_df["before"].values)
train_features.insert(1, "sentence_id", train_df["sentence_id"].values)
train_features.insert(2, "token_id", train_df["token_id"].values)
train_features.insert(3, "class", train_df["class"].values)
train_features.insert(4, "after", train_df["after"].values)
train_features.insert(5, "id", train_ids)

# Split into train/validation using hold-out split (never refit on full data)
val_indices = np.random.choice(len(train_features), size=20000, replace=False)
val_idx_list = np.array(val_indices)
train_idx_list = np.array(
    [i for i in range(len(train_features)) if i not in val_indices]
)

train_val = train_features.iloc[train_idx_list]
validation = train_features.iloc[val_idx_list]

# Get validation target
target_val = validation["after"]

# Fit on training data using vectorizer
text_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_df=0.9, min_df=10, max_features=5000, stop_words="english"
)
X_val_vec = text_vectorizer.transform(validation["before"].astype(str))

# Use Random Forest for baseline classification
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier

model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=200, max_depth=15, n_jobs=-1, random_state=42
)
model.fit(validation["before"].astype(str).values, target_val.values)

# Predict on validation (held-out) set
validation_preds = model.predict(validation["before"].astype(str).values)
val_accuracy = np.mean(np.round(target_val.values == validation_preds.values))
print(f"Hold-out Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")

# Generate final predictions on test set
test_features = []
for _, row in test_df.iterrows():
    feat = create_token_features(row["before"])
    test_features.append(feat)

test_features = pd.DataFrame(test_features)
test_features.insert(0, "before", test_df["before"].values)
test_features.insert(1, "sentence_id", test_df["sentence_id"].values)
test_features.insert(2, "token_id", test_df["token_id"].values)
test_features.insert(3, "class", pd.Series(["PLAIN"] * len(test_features)))

test_input = test_features["before"].astype(str).values
test_predictions = model.predict(test_input)

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "after": test_predictions})

# Write submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Saved predictions to ./submission/submission.csv")
